facts.fact: The Communications Authority and KNBS released an analytical report on ICT uptake based on the 2022 Kenya Demographic and Health Survey, covering 42,022 households in 1,692 clusters.

KEN.note: Document states nothing on the central bank's payments role.
Document states nothing on consumer protection rules or redress for digital finance.
Document states nothing on cross-border payments.
Only daily-use shares among users and household figures; no share of all people using the internet in rural and urban areas, and no programme counted.
Document states nothing on government payments to people.
Only household internet use by electricity status and daily-use shares; no national share of people using the internet.
Only household phone ownership and subscriptions per 100; no share of people owning a phone.
No survey share of adults with an account; mobile money penetration figure is not that.
Document states nothing on retail payment services beyond a mobile money penetration figure with no service detail.
Document states nothing on tax or fee payment.
No rural electricity access figure stated.
